text.en:
Section fifteen, paragraph (e) of Republic Act Numbered Four Thousand Three Hundred Seventy
Four, as amended, is further amended to read as follows:
"(e) To qualify in the Junior Geodetic Engineer Examination, he must, likewise, satisfy the foregoing
requirements (a) to (c) of this Section, and that he is a holder of the degree of Associate in Surveying, or a
holder of the degree of Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering, or has completed third year in Geodetic
Engineering or Civil Engineering and has earned to his credit the following courses: Laws on Natural
Resources, Laws on Land Registration and Property, Land Reform Laws, Land Property Surveys,
Photogrammetry and Cartography from any recognized school, college or university.

A certificate of registration as Junior Geodetic Engineer shall authorize the holder thereof to
execute land surveys or phases thereof, subject to such conditions and limitations as may be prescribed by the

Board of Geodetic Engineers.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 13th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
